steps.say: The launch chart says a small adapter takes Qwen's twenty-seven billion parameter model from twenty-nine percent to sixty-three.

steps.caption: the card now says 39.2%
steps.say: The model card now says thirty-nine. Nine of the base model's runs had died on a broken network tunnel.

scenes.headline: A LoRA that learns one agent's habits
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Banjo. I read the adapter's tensors and three model cards.

steps.caption: solved in 8 tool calls
steps.say: Same task under pi. The adapter greps, reads, edits, tests, and is done in eight calls.
The base model keeps probing with inline Python until it runs out of its one hundred.

states.say: I read the adapter's header by range request. All sixty-four layers get an adapter on the MLP.

states.term: LoRA: two thin matrices beside a frozen one
states.say: Only sixteen get attention adapters. The other forty-eight are linear attention, whose names the target list never matches.

steps.say: Training runs pi itself, in a sandbox, on bug fixes and terminal tasks.
vLLM keeps the exact tokens the policy sampled.
The task's tests decide right or wrong.
Eight rollouts of each task are compared.
And the new adapter is loaded by name.

scenes.title: Why a tiny bonus halves the turns

steps.label: Three of eight correct
steps.say: The reward is one for passing the tests, plus at most a tenth for using fewer tool calls.

steps.label: Three of eight correct
steps.term: Advantage: reward minus the group mean, over its spread
steps.say: GRPO compares the group. When some fail, being right is the whole signal.

steps.label: All eight correct
steps.say: Once all eight pass, they differ only in how many calls they took.

steps.label: All eight correct
steps.say: Normalised, that tiny bonus becomes the entire signal. Short solutions are pushed up hard.

steps.caption: pi: 15.7 to 6.9 calls
steps.say: Tool calls per solved training rollout fall steadily in every run.

steps.caption: 39.2% to 64.7%
steps.say: Under pi, the hard half of SWE-bench Pro goes from thirty-nine to about sixty-five percent.

steps.caption: 39.5% to 55.8%
steps.say: Terminal-Bench goes from about forty to fifty-six, and holds on held-out tasks.

scenes.title: Thousands of tokens per SWE-bench Pro task
scenes.say: Thinking at full effort still solves a little more on SWE-bench Pro, not significantly, at about five times the tokens.

items.say: The sibling adapters gain less, and three of their four results do not clear a sign test.
And no card tests an adapter in an agent it was not trained in.

scenes.text: A harness adapter makes the model decisive in one agent. Accuracy depends on the agent.
scenes.say: A harness adapter makes the model decisive in one agent. Whether it is more accurate depends on the agent.

recap: Reward: pass the tests, then fewer calls
scenes.say: A small LoRA, a reward for passing and then for brevity. Thanks for watching!
